name: Noosa Ocean Rider
summary: Noosa Ocean Rider runs small-group trips from Noosa Marina on a fast 8.8m rigid inflatable boat that seats no more than 12. Trips follow the Noosa National Park coastline to look for the local dolphins, and head out to sea for humpback whales in season. A father and son team of captains runs the boat.
standouts: Maximum 12 passengers in six rows of two, so every seat is a window seat
Father and son captains Michael and Ozzie Black, with over 30 years combined experience
Volunteers from Humpbacks and High-rises have joined its whale watching tours to collect data since the 2021 season

contact.address: Noosa Marina, Parkyn Court, Tewantin QLD 4565

trips.title: Ocean Tour & Dolphin Safari
trips.summary: A fast ride out of the Noosa River and along the coast past the headlands and Noosa National Park, to Alexandra Bay, Hells Gate, the Fairy Pools and Devil's Kitchen. Around 200 Indo-Pacific dolphins live in these waters, and turtles and rays are often seen. Raincoats and goggles are provided.
highlights: Coastline past Noosa National Park to Alexandra Bay, Hells Gate, the Fairy Pools, Paradise Cove and Devil's Kitchen
Around 200 Indo-Pacific dolphins live along this coast
Maximum 12 passengers
Raincoat and action goggles provided

trips.title: Whale Watching Adventures
trips.summary: A two-hour small-group whale watch that leaves Noosa Marina, runs down the Noosa River and heads out past Noosa Heads and the National Park to find humpback whales on their migration. With no more than 12 on board, everyone sits close to the water. Later in the season mothers and calves are often seen heading south.
highlights: Maximum 12 passengers on an 8.8m Gemini expedition boat
Experienced skipper and dedicated whale spotting
Raincoat, action goggles and binoculars provided
Humpbacks and High-rises volunteers join tours to gather research data

trips.title: Ocean Tour, Whale & Dolphin Safari
trips.summary: An end-of-season trip along the Noosa coast that combines the dolphin route with a search for the last humpbacks heading south. Over 200 Indo-Pacific dolphins live along this coast, and bottlenose dolphins come closer to shore at this time of year. Spray jackets are provided.
highlights: Run at the end of whale season, with a chance of humpbacks heading south
Indo-Pacific and bottlenose dolphins along the Noosa coastline
Turtle mating season at this time of year
Group size 12

trips.title: Private Charter
trips.summary: The boat can be booked for a private group for whale watching, a dolphin safari or an ocean ride along the coast. It suits birthdays, bucks and hens parties, school, corporate and conference groups. Bookings are made by phone.
highlights: Private whale watching, dolphin safari or ocean adventure
For birthdays, bucks and hens parties, corporate, school and conference groups

Additional tour times available on request

trips.title: Learn to Freedive with OceanSense
trips.summary: A two-day freediving course in Noosa, run by OceanSense and hosted by Noosa Oceanrider. It leads to certification and includes time in the water around Noosa National Park.
highlights: 2 full days
Certification course
Freediving around Noosa National Park
Run by OceanSense, hosted by Noosa Oceanrider
